status: DECLARED public coordination schema; not a measurement protocol

axial_lift.normal_form: Lambda = (k + u) T, k in Z, 0 <= u < 1

finite_address.encoding: a mod 4 = q; a mod 137 = s

iris_dome.law: a mod 4 = q; a mod 137 = s
iris_dome.geometry: four phase bands; 137 iris sectors per band
iris_dome.feedback: Display output does not update the MOONLIGHT phase mirror.

dome_receipt.status: DECLARED export record; reader-supplied; nothing is captured automatically
dome_receipt.directed_check: Dome receipt -> this schema (path, version) -> pinned Dome bytes

source.note: The receipt names this schema by path and version only. The Dome hash is pinned in sources.iris_dome, one way.

dome.s_rule: When s_input is present, require s = s_input mod 137 (non-negative residue). When s_input is omitted, require canonical s in 0..136 directly.

checks.rule: Each value is the truth of the stated equality for the recorded a, and must equal its recomputation.

delta.rule: Empty when the recorded a equals the recomputation from q and s. Otherwise one entry {recorded_a, recomputed_a}.

reader.label: REQUIRED non-empty string supplied by the reader; no identity is captured automatically.

coordinate_separation.rule: No identity or adapter between these coordinates is supplied by this schema.

boundaries.D4: No map V -> E is supplied or used.
boundaries.dome: A 137-side visual iris requires its own declared mesh and index adapter.
boundaries.feedback: No display output updates the MOONLIGHT phase mirror.
